samples.summary: `FontRegistry.ensureFont` short-circuits on `document.fonts.check()`, which a `&text=` subset face now satisfies — a previewed family gets permanently marked 'loaded' from a face that holds only the label's glyphs
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:302` does `if (document.fonts.check(fontSpec)) { this.status.set(key,'loaded'); return; }`. Before this change, a row scrolling into view in the docs font dropdown injected the FULL family link (`ensureFontLink`), so any registered face for that family really was the full family. Now `font-family-picker.tsx:149` injects a subset link instead, so by the time the docs toolbar's prefetch/apply path runs (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:345-355`: `ensureFontLink(family)` then `store.fonts?.ensureFont?.(family)`), `check()` answers true off the subset face; the registry records 'loaded', never awaits the real face and never fires its `onFontLoaded` listeners (fonts.ts:320) — so the Canvas re-layout that depends on the registry is skipped, and if the full CSS request fails there is no retry (status is already 'loaded'). Fix likely belongs on the new code (mark subset links so they are not registered/consulted as a full load, or preview only for rows the registry does not measure).

samples.summary: Slides PDF export awaits `document.fonts.load(...)`, which can now resolve against a preview subset face while the full family stylesheet is still in flight, rasterising the deck with label-only glyphs
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:31-39` calls `ensureFontLink(family)` and then `await document.fonts.load('16px "family"')`. `document.fonts.load` only waits on faces already registered in the FontFaceSet; if the user previewed that family in the picker, a `&text=`-subset face (no `unicode-range`) is registered and loaded, so `load()` can resolve immediately while the just-injected full stylesheet has not been parsed, and `exportSlidesPdf` then measures/paints with the subset face. Previously previewing injected the full family, so this ordering hazard did not exist. Same shape at `packages/docs/src/export/pdf-exporter.ts:250-257` (mitigated there because Noto Sans/Serif KR are `eager: true`, so previews no-op for them).

finding.summary: `verify:frame` is the one build-staleness gate left un-updated: it still rebuilds only `dist/shell`, yet it boots the fixture consumer whose vite.config imports the package BY NAME (→ `dist/plugin/index.js`)
finding.evidence: The diff fixed exactly this in `verify-consumer.mjs`, `verify-scenes.mjs`, `verify-tokens.mjs` and `scripts/design.mjs`, but `packages/design-editor/scripts/verify-frame.mjs:82-91` still runs only `vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts` and compares against `dist/shell/index.html` alone (`newestSourceMtime` at :95-108 also omits `tsconfig.build.json`). Its `boot()` at :118-124 starts vite on `PROJECT = packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer` (:46), and `fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17` does `import { designEditor, cssVariables } from '@wafflebase/design-editor'`, which `package.json:6-10` resolves to `./dist/plugin/index.js`. On a clean checkout (`dist/` is gitignored) the dev server dies with `Cannot find module …/dist/plugin/index.js`, reported as 'dev server exited early'; on a dirty one the browser gate runs against plugin bytes older than the change under test — the precise stale-bytes trap the diff's own comments say is 'worse than no gate'.

verdict.reason:
Verified directly in the repo. `packages/design-editor/package.json:6-10` resolves `exports["."]` to `./dist/plugin/index.js` (built by `build:plugin` = `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, package.json:19-21). `packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17` imports `{ designEditor, cssVariables } from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` by name (its own header comment at :9-12 states this deliberately exercises the exports map), so booting that fixture requires `dist/plugin/index.js` to exist and be current.

`verify-frame.mjs` boots exactly that fixture: `PROJECT = packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer` (:46) and `boot()` (:118-124) spawns `vite PROJECT --config .../vite.config.ts`. Yet its staleness gate `buildShellIfStale()` (:82-91, called at :147) only checks `dist/shell/index.html` and runs `vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts`; `newestSourceMtime()` (:95-108) walks `src/` and stats only `vite.shell.config.ts`, omitting `tsconfig.build.json`. Nothing in this script ever builds or checks `dist/plugin/index.js`.

The sibling scripts do handle it: `verify-consumer.mjs:203-215` checks BOTH `dist/shell/index.html` and `dist/plugin/index.js` and runs `pnpm run build`, with :183-201 spelling out the exact failure mode ("Rebuilding only the shell therefore left a clean checkout failing on `Cannot find module` … and a dirty one running all 57 checks against plugin bytes older than the change under test"), and explicitly naming `verify:frame` as having "the same shape" (:198). `packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-scenes.mjs:92-95` and `verify-tokens.mjs:166-169` use the same fixed two-artefact pattern. So `verify-frame.mjs` is the one un-updated consumer of the `exports["."] → dist/plugin` contract.

This is squarely in the blast-radius lane: a contract change (package entry now a built artefact) with a call site left un-updated, and the failure is invisible in the diff. Severity major stands — on a clean checkout (`dist/` gitignored) the run dies as "dev server exited early"; on a dirty one the whole browser gate asserts against stale plugin bytes, i.e. a green that is not evidence. Being an opt-in local gate (header :26-29) reduces frequency, not impact, and does not make it non-real. No guard elsewhere rescues it: `verify:frame` is invoked as `node ./scripts/verify-frame.mjs` (package.json:23) with no prior build step.

verdict.reason: The quoted code exists (fonts.ts:301-305 short-circuits on document.fonts.check; font-family-picker.tsx:148-153 injects a &text= subset link via ensurePreviewFontLink, font-catalog.ts:258-284), but the consumer the finding claims is broken is unreachable in this repository. The only in-repo path to FontRegistry.ensureFont is the optional-chained call at docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:351-354 (`store.fonts?.ensureFont?.(family)`), and no store ever carries a `fonts` field: the DocStore interface (packages/docs/src/store/store.ts:11+) declares none, MemDocStore (packages/docs/src/store/memory.ts:32) and YorkieDocStore (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:549) define none, and a repo-wide grep for `.fonts =` yields zero assignments. FontRegistry is never constructed outside a unit test (only match for `new FontRegistry` is packages/docs/test/view/fonts.test.ts:63) and nothing subscribes via onFontLoaded (only declaration, fonts.ts:285). So the registry cannot be poisoned into a permanent 'loaded' state, no Canvas re-layout listener is skipped, and the no-retry consequence cannot occur on any reachable path. The claimed blast-radius consumer is inert code guarded by the optional chain.

finding.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:31-39` calls `ensureFontLink(family)` and then `await document.fonts.load('16px "family"')`. `document.fonts.load` only waits on faces already registered in the FontFaceSet; if the user previewed that family in the picker, a `&text=`-subset face (no `unicode-range`) is registered and loaded, so `load()` can resolve immediately while the just-injected full stylesheet has not been parsed, and `exportSlidesPdf` then measures/paints with the subset face. Previously previewing injected the full family, so this ordering hazard did not exist. Same shape at `packages/docs/src/export/pdf-exporter.ts:250-257` (mitigated there because Noto Sans/Serif KR are `eager: true`, so previews no-op for them).

verdict.reason: Code is present exactly as described. packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:30-40 calls ensureFontLink(family) then awaits document.fonts.load(`16px "family"`) as its sole font-readiness gate (comment at :14-17 states that contract). The new preview path, ensurePreviewFontLink (font-catalog.ts:258-284), registers a `&text=` subset face under a separate marker attribute that findFontLink (:123-131) and hence ensureFontLink cannot see, and the module's own comment (:203-206) asserts such a face carries no unicode-range — so it matches every codepoint for face selection while holding only the row's glyphs. That subset face is reachable for deck families: font-family-picker.tsx:138-165 previews every curated dropdown row that scrolls into view, and non-eager entries such as Lobster (font-catalog.data.ts:75) get subset-only faces; nothing in packages/frontend/src/app/slides full-links a deck's used families at load (grep shows ensureFontLink only in pdf-actions.ts, apply-font-family.ts, theme-builder-panel.tsx, hover onPrefetch), so hasFullFamilyLink (:214-233) does not suppress the subset in a fresh open-picker-then-export session. The defensive `await document.fonts.ready` in packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts:120-126 does not cover it — its docstring (:94-97) explicitly puts font loading on the caller and notes the exporter cannot initiate lazy font CSS. The second cited site (packages/docs/src/export/pdf-exporter.ts:250-258) is real and, as the reviewer says, mitigated because Noto Sans/Serif KR are eager (font-catalog.data.ts:6-7), which makes the preview no-op at font-catalog.ts:266. This is an out-of-diff consumer relying on an invariant the preview change breaks ("a registered face for a family covers the whole family") — squarely in the blast-radius lane at major.

finding.summary: verify-consumer's auto-build only builds the SHELL, but the fixture now resolves the package through `exports` → `dist/plugin/index.js`
finding.evidence: `buildShellIfMissing()` (packages/design-editor/scripts/verify-consumer.mjs:197-206) runs only `vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts`; the plugin half of `build` (`tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, packages/design-editor/package.json:20-21) is never run. `boot()` (verify-consumer.mjs:117-128) starts vite on `fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts`, which imports the package BY NAME (packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17) and therefore resolves `exports["."] = ./dist/plugin/index.js` (packages/design-editor/package.json:6-10). On a clean checkout `dist/plugin/` does not exist, so the dev server dies and the gate reports `dev server exited early` instead of a verdict; worse, when `dist/plugin` exists but is older than `src/plugin`, the freshness check (which only stats `dist/shell/index.html`, line 198-199) lets the whole 57-check gate pass against STALE plugin bytes — exactly the failure the comment at lines 189-196 says is worse than no gate. The delta's new comment at line 171 asserts the build is covered by the `design-editor:build` lane, but this script is explicitly out of verify:fast/verify:self (line 24-29), so no lane builds anything before it runs. Fix belongs here: build (or staleness-check) `dist/plugin` too.

verdict.reason: The code is not as described. There is no `buildShellIfMissing()` in verify-consumer.mjs; the function is `buildIfStale()` (verify-consumer.mjs:203-215) and it already does exactly what the finding asks for. It staleness-checks BOTH artefacts — `['dist/shell/index.html', 'dist/plugin/index.js'].filter(stale)` at line 209 — where `stale` (lines 205-208) fires on missing OR older-than-source, and `newestSourceMtime()` (166-181) folds in all of `src/` plus both `vite.shell.config.ts` and `tsconfig.build.json`. When either is outdated it runs the package's own `pnpm run build` (line 213), which is `build:shell && build:plugin` (package.json:19-21); `build:plugin` is `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, whose outDir/rootDir/include (tsconfig.build.json:26-27,37) emit `dist/plugin/index.js` — the exact target of `exports["."]` (package.json:6-10) that the by-name fixture import (fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17) resolves. `buildIfStale()` is the first statement of `main()` (line 218), before `boot()` (line 220), so neither the clean-checkout `Cannot find module` path nor the stale-plugin-bytes path is reachable. The cited comment is also inverted: line 171 is `if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full);`, and the doc comment at 183-202 explicitly says "BOTH ARTEFACTS, not just the shell" and "NOTHING IN CI RUNS THIS SCRIPT … `design-editor:build` therefore guarantees this script nothing" — the opposite of what the finding attributes to it. The finding describes a prior revision.

finding.summary: verify-scenes rebuilds only design-editor's shell, but the vite config it boots now imports the package's built plugin entry
finding.evidence: `buildShellIfStale()` (packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-scenes.mjs:66-87) stats only `packages/design-editor/dist/shell/index.html` and rebuilds only `vite.shell.config.ts`. `boot()` (line 89-93) then starts vite on `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts`, which does `import { designEditor, BASE } from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` (packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts:49) — since #966 that resolves to `dist/plugin/index.js`. On a checkout where only the shell exists (which this very function can produce), the config fails to load and the script reports `dev server exited early: Cannot find module …/dist/plugin/index.js`. It builds `@wafflebase/core` when stale (line 204-218) but has no equivalent for the plugin dist.

verdict.reason: The code is not as described at the cited location. `packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-scenes.mjs:80` defines `buildDesignEditorIfStale()` (not `buildShellIfStale()`), and its staleness set at line 95 is `['dist/shell/index.html', 'dist/plugin/index.js']` — it stats the plugin entry for both existence and mtime, against `src/` plus BOTH build configs (`vite.shell.config.ts` and `tsconfig.build.json`, lines 92-94). When either artefact is outdated it runs the package's full `pnpm run build` (line 102), which per `packages/design-editor/package.json:21` is `build:shell && build:plugin`, where `build:plugin` (line 20) is `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` and produces `dist/plugin/index.js` — precisely the file `exports["."]` names (package.json:9) and that `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts:49` imports. This build is awaited at verify-scenes.mjs:241 before `boot()` at line 243, so the config cannot load against a missing/stale plugin dist. The function's own doc comment (lines 66-79) names the exact `Cannot find module …/dist/plugin/index.js` failure as the reason it was already changed. The name `buildShellIfStale` does exist but in a different package and file — `packages/design-editor/scripts/verify-frame.mjs:82`, which boots the fixture consumer project, not `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts` — so it is not the site or config this finding cites.

finding.summary: verify-tokens boots vite with no design-editor build at all; only `predev` covers the plugin dist
finding.evidence: `boot()` (packages/design-sandbox/scripts/verify-tokens.mjs:97-108) spawns `pnpm exec vite` in `packages/design-sandbox`, loading `vite.config.ts:49`'s `import … from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` → `dist/plugin/index.js`. The package only prebuilds design-editor for `dev` (`predev`, packages/design-sandbox/package.json:10); `verify:tokens` (line 12) and `verify:scenes` (line 13) have no such hook, so on an unbuilt checkout these manual gates fail on a missing module rather than on the thing under test. The delta added `design-editor:build` for exactly this class of failure in CI lanes but left these two entry points reaching the same dist without it.

verdict.reason: The finding's core factual claim is false. verify-tokens.mjs does build design-editor before booting vite: main() calls buildDesignEditorIfStale() as its first statement (scripts/verify-tokens.mjs:180) before boot() (:182), and that function (:154-177) checks BOTH dist/shell/index.html and dist/plugin/index.js for missing-or-stale via `!existsSync(artefact) || statSync(artefact).mtimeMs < newest` (:169-172) and runs `pnpm run build` in packages/design-editor (:175), throwing on failure (:176). The script's own comment at :138-153 states precisely the reasoning the finding says is missing ("`verify:tokens` has no such hook … the build has to happen here"). The finding's second cited entry point is likewise covered: verify-scenes.mjs has the same mtime-based guard (:80-106, checking dist/plugin/index.js at :95-98) awaited as the first statement of main() (:241) before boot() (:243). So on an unbuilt checkout neither gate reaches vite.config.ts:49's `import … from '@wafflebase/design-editor'` with an absent dist/plugin/index.js; the absence of a package.json pre-hook is immaterial because the in-script build is strictly stronger than `predev`. Code not present as described.
